import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the seed dataset
seed_data_path = '/Users/bytedance/Desktop/bench/seed_datasets/scientific/weather_stations.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(seed_data_path)

# Rename columns for semantic obfuscation
df.rename(columns={
    'date': 'measurement_date',
    'station': 'location_code',
    'latitude': 'geo_latitude',
    'temp_celsius': 'temperature_C',
    'precipitation_mm': 'rainfall_mm',
    'humidity_percent': 'humidity_pct',
    'wind_speed_kmh': 'wind_velocity_kmh'
}, inplace=True)

# Create a DataFrame for the canary value
canary_df = pd.DataFrame([{
    'measurement_date': '2023-01-06',
    'location_code': 'STN_CANARY',
    'geo_latitude': 50,
    'temperature_C': -999,
    'rainfall_mm': 0,
    'humidity_pct': 0,
    'wind_velocity_kmh': 0
}])

# Concatenate the canary DataFrame to the original DataFrame
df = pd.concat([df, canary_df], ignore_index=True)

# Apply noise to temperature data to simulate measurement errors
np.random.seed(42)
noise = np.random.normal(0, 0.5, df.shape[0])
df['temperature_C'] += noise

# Save the mutated dataset
df.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)
